name: wingbar Brand Palette
description: Native macOS palette derived from the titanium black app icon and wingbar status bar themes

titanium-950.name: Titanium 950 (Midnight Void)
titanium-950.role: Dark theme canvas background, deepest surface, squircle base bottom, menu-bar notch

titanium-900.name: Titanium 900 (Deep Slate)
titanium-900.role: Dark theme panel/card background, widget background, dropdown menu surface

titanium-800.name: Titanium 800 (Charcoal Horizon)
titanium-800.role: Squircle base top, elevated widget fill, light theme primary text and glyph fill

titanium-600.name: Titanium 600 (Muted Steel)
titanium-600.role: Dark theme secondary text, light theme borders, subtle dividers

titanium-500.name: Titanium 500 (Cool Slate)
titanium-500.role: Dark theme muted text, subtle telemetry labels, accessible tertiary text (WCAG 4.6:1 AA on Titanium 950)

pearl-200.name: Pearl 200 (Cool Mist)
pearl-200.role: Dark theme glyph bottom gradient stop, light theme card borders and secondary surface

pearl-100.name: Pearl 100 (Pearl White)
pearl-100.role: Dark theme glyph mid gradient stop, light theme elevated surface fill

pearl-50.name: Pearl 50 (Pure Specular)
pearl-50.role: Dark theme primary text and glyph specular highlight, light theme canvas background

specular-ice.name: Specular Ice (Rim Blue)
specular-ice.role: Icon specular rim light, active keyboard focus ring, cool accent

emerald-active.name: Wing Green (Status Active)
emerald-active.role: Dark theme primary brand accent, active workspace/CI passing indicator, online status

emerald-accessible.name: Emerald Deep (Light Mode Accent)
emerald-accessible.role: Light theme primary brand accent, high-contrast text and interactive state

cyan-info.name: Terminal Cyan (Status Info)
cyan-info.role: Dark theme secondary accent, network/CPU telemetry indicator

cyan-accessible.name: Cyan Deep (Light Mode Info)
cyan-accessible.role: Light theme secondary accent, network/CPU telemetry text
